comment: Win or lose, captain Scheffler cancels the majority of the opposition, so the objective is to chip away on the margins (or defend against it). A good reminder that we play the long game, the dynamics in fantasy this week essentially are the opposite of the energy in reality at TPC Scottsdale.

comment: I’m taking a bold stance to only captain Scheffler at events he has won multiple times in Segment 1. Still going to max him out.
Bad choices have led me to break from my original plan! After destroying Schauffele's streak of cuts made last week, I'll gladly be the mush again in the Sonoran Desert.
His consistency has been a worry in the past, but after three straight solid weeks, I’m sold. While his history here is not as strong as some others, he's got a good chance as any.

It’s chalky, but you’ve got to use him three times this segment and this is one of the three best fits. Going with limited risk here, knowing I’m taking a few others down the board with my other selections. That’s where I’ll hope to pick up value on the field.
On a track that requires tee-to-green excellence, look for Benny Booms to assert himself. Hasn’t finished outside the top 25 yet this year.
